rationale: The previous candidate maintained excellent geometry and sensor layout with stable control and zero line loss events. I expect these adjustments to reduce steering oscillations further, maintain zero line loss events, and improve completion time. I request measurements including completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to verify these hypotheses.
